changelog:
**Expanded permission controls and clarified data boundaries**

- Added a formal MCP Permission Declaration section outlining all network, filesystem, environment, billing, credential, and data-handling boundaries.
- Replaced previous freeform frontmatter permission notes with structured, explicit permission schemas in SKILL.md.
- Denied all arbitrary shell, file, environment, and network access except for essential functionality.
- Documented new/updated policies on what data may never be exported or collected (including attachment/file/base64 exports and credential requests).
- Usage and user-facing behavior remain unchanged; all controls clarify and enforce the existing privacy guarantees.
